push.title: W 5-2 vs Warrior Minded | You: 9.3 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 9.3, tuxedo_slide. That's the sort of game that makes the whole locker room stand a little taller.

THE GOOD
+ Won 3 of 5 tackles (up from your usual 24%). You stayed on your feet and won it anyway. That's a skill.
+ A brace against Warrior Minded, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's how you turn a chance into a memory.
+ 1 key pass. That's a pass with a bow on it.
+ Man of the Match, your 3rd for us. Leaders make the hard moments look easy.
+ You and PhogsToffees turned simple passes into goals.

THE BAD
- 62% passing (13 of 21, up from your usual 50%). Here's a thought: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Small fix, big smile.
- 2 goals conceded took 0.1 off your rating. Easy points to win back.
- Worst missed tackles of your 4 matches this session (2). Coach's secret: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.

Training note: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.

tuxedo_slide, something I want you to sleep on: There's no 'I' in team, but there's a 'me' if you scramble it. Don't scramble it.

You make this job too easy. Don't tell the gaffer. - Coach Lasso
